newsitem.title: UK: Smith & Nephew, Mass. Univ. in research pact.
newsitem.headline: Smith & Nephew, Mass. Univ. in research pact.

text.p: Smith & Nephew Plc on Thursday said it entered into an agreement with the University of Massachusetts to form a research centre to develop new endoscopic procedures and instrumentation for minimally invasive surgery.
The research centre is expected to eventually link into other universities and surgical centres worldwide.

U.S.-based University of Massachusetts will provide the centre's office space and access to surgical facilities as well as technical and research assistance. Smith & Nephew will devote four full-time engineers to the centre and provide funding and other support totalling about $2 million a year.
